completionEvidence.description: QEMU 11.1.3 -accel help lists tcg and whpx; VM started with -accel whpx,kernel-irqchip=off.
Fresh console log reached login prompt 14.1 seconds after process start.
SSH through 127.0.0.1:10022 returned cloud-init marker 'boot-ok' and Linux kernel 6.8.0-147-generic.
Ubuntu 24.04 noble-server-cloudimg-amd64.img SHA256 verified against mirror SHA256SUMS.

notes: Attempts 1-2 also booted and reached SSH; attempt 2 boot timing was discarded because the console log had not been rotated. QEMU prints non-fatal 'failed to get xsave state' warnings on this WHPX build.
